title.narrative: Investing for impact against Tuberculosis and HIV - Ukraine (01-Jan-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Ukraine, TB/HIV, State Institution "Public Health Center of the Ministry of Health of Ukraine" (PHC Ukraine)This program has the following goals: To reduce the TB and HIV/AIDS-related morbidity and mortality in Ukraine. The objectives of this program are: To scale up and ensure equitable access to high quality TB and HIV prevention, treatment, care and support with a focus on key affected populations (MARPs, PLWHA and other people most affected by the HIV and TB. To strengthen community systems that enable needs-based, cost-effective and integrated interventions for key populations mostly affected by the HIV and TB epidemic. To strengthen the health systems towards sustainable and integrated solutions for key populations mostly affected by the HIV and TB epidemic
